answer_1.quote: Multi-turn dialogue systems are fundamental to both task-oriented and open-domain conversational agents, enabling coherent and natural interactions.

answer_2.quote: We employ the reward-model-deberta-v3-large-v2 (OpenAssistant, 2023) to score conversations.
automatic_metrics: GPT-4 scores on Faithfulness, Appropriateness, Naturalness, Completeness

answer_3.quote: All evaluations followed the GPT-4-based "LLM-as-a-Judger" protocol, which was used both to compute Win Rate via pairwise comparisons and to assign fine-grained scores across four human-aligned criteria: Faithfulness (Faith.), Appropriateness (Appr.), Naturalness (Nat.), and Completeness (Compl.).

answer_4.quote: Model evaluations are conducted by three trained research assistants, each paid $20/hour, above the local average.
answer_4.guideline: The four evaluation aspects in section 4.1 are defined as: Connection, Quality, Information Density, and Friendliness.
